title: Vaporwave Studies
description: Nine independent 80s-vaporwave compositions — liquid-chrome extruded type, magenta-cyan split neon, pink gridded horizons, oversized setting suns, and wireframe peaks rendered at modern precision.
creative_direction: Every image is a standalone vaporwave composition exploring one axis — typography, horizon, architecture, sunset — with consistent chromatic grammar: magenta + cyan + pink grid + chrome reflections + VHS scanline shimmer. No shared scenes between images.
